// A planar blob system: the field value at a point is the summed influence
// of all balls minus Threshold, so the zero level set is the blob outline.
type MetaBallSystem2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Balls: Array<MetaBall2D>;
    Threshold: Number;
}
